highlights:
Introducing Verda Inference, now in preview with Kimi K3.1 Pro

# Introducing Verda Inference, now in preview with Kimi K3.1 Pro 

 Nov 4, 2026 | Mukund Birje | 8 min read 

 AI teams already train, fine-tune and serve their models on Verda, from dedicated GPU clusters to serverless containers that scale with demand. Today, we’re adding the layer above. Verda Inference is our model-as-a-service (MaaS) offering: managed inference for frontier open-weight models, built for AI teams who need consistent performance and reliability for their applications and agents at scale. We handle the GPUs, the models and the serving in our own data centers in Europe, so you can focus on what you’re building and pay only for the tokens you use. 

 We’re launching in partnership with Moonshot AI, starting with Kimi K3.1 Pro, the highest-ranked open-weight model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. As a European launch partner of Moonshot AI, we’ll bring new Kimi models and versions to Verda Inference as their open weights are released, for builders in Europe and around the world. For developers building on open-weight models, that means access to Moonshot’s newest releases from day zero, so you can always build with the most capable models and stay at the frontier.

...

## Built for AI builders 

- Compatibility with your existing code: With an OpenAI compatible API, moving your code over means changing the base URL, API key and model ID. Your agents, frameworks and tools keep working as they are. 
- Choice of frontier open-weight models: Verda Inference is built to serve a range of leading open-weight models through one API. You can use the right model for each task and switch between them by changing one line of code. 
- Pricing that rewards long sessions: You pay only for the tokens you use, deducted from your prepaid Verda balance like the rest of the platform. 
- One console for inference and compute: You create API keys and track token usage, including cached tokens, in the same Verda console as your instances, clusters and storage. 

## Kimi K3.1 Pro pricing on Verda Inference 

 Billed per token, Verda Inference rewards long sessions with multiple optimizations improving long-context agentic workloads as described earlier in this article. 

 Our Kimi K3.1 Pro pricing is per 1M tokens. 

- Input at $2.00 
- Cache read at $0.20 
- Output $10.00 

 Cache read applies to input tokens that match a recently processed prompt prefix. Everything else is billed at the input rate. Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens.

...

## Try Verda Inference in preview 

 Verda Inference is available in preview from today, starting with Kimi K3.1 Pro. See the pricing page for current prices. 

 We’ll make more leading open-weight models available soon, along with service tiers for everything you need, from faster responses to lower cost batch work. Tell us what you’re building, and what you’d like us to add next. 

 Sign in to the Verda console to make your first call, or read the documentation to learn more. Usage limits apply during the preview. Planning a larger workload? Get in touch with our team to help you size it and get it running.

results.title: Verda Object Storage is now in beta
highlights:
Verda Object Storage is now in beta

# Verda Object Storage is now in beta 

 Oct 28, 2026 | Mukund Birje, Phillip Williams & Klaus Julin | 4 min read 

 Verda Object Storage is now available in beta to all Verda customers. It is S3-compatible storage for the data behind your AI work, whether you're training, fine-tuning or serving models. Built and operated by Verda, it's managed in the console alongside your instances and clusters and works with the tools you already use. You pay only for the data you store. Uploads, downloads and API requests are free.

...

### Pricing and availability 

 During beta, Object Storage is available in FIN-03, with default quotas of 1 TiB of storage, 100,000 objects and 100 buckets. You can request more anytime from Account settings > Quotas. 

 You pay $0.07 per GiB stored per month, billed from your prepaid balance like your other Verda resources. There are no fees for egress, ingress or API requests, and no subscription or minimum commitment.
